# Documents and what keeps them true

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-agents-md.mjs from docs/state-surfaces.json (pnpm agents:generate); do not hand-edit. Not shipped in the npm package. -->

Built from `docs/state-surfaces.json`, which `scripts/check-state-surfaces.mjs` gates. Re-read an editorial document, bump its `reviewedAt` there (today or earlier), then run `pnpm agents:generate`. The short entry point is `docs/ai/FRONT-DOOR.md`.

## Generated

A script builds it: change its source, never the file. A named check fails when the file is stale; where no check is named, nothing compares the file with a fresh build.

- `README.md` (auto:front-door-counts): Front-door counts. Built by `scripts/build-readme-counts.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/build-readme-counts.mjs --check` passes.
- `README.md` (auto:consumer-usage): Who uses HDS (consumer usage). Built by `scripts/count-consumer-usage.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/count-consumer-usage.mjs --check` passes.
- `public/hds-stats.json`: The HDS numbers other repos read (component, core, pattern and token counts, contrast pairs, typography styles, the consumer split), each computed from the code. Built by `scripts/build-stats-json.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/build-stats-json.mjs --check` passes.
- `README.md` (auto:core-set): The core set of components. Built by `scripts/build-readme-counts.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/build-readme-counts.mjs --check` passes.
- `AGENTS.md` (consumer guide): Consumer agent instructions shipped in the package. Built by `scripts/generate-agents-md.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/generate-agents-md.mjs --check` passes.
- `docs/ai/FRONT-DOOR.md`: Front door for an agent working in this repo: what it is, read order, where live state is (short, always-on; not shipped in the package). Built by `scripts/generate-agents-md.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/generate-agents-md.mjs --check` passes.
- `docs/ai/DOCS-INDEX.md`: Every registered document in this registry by kind, and how each is kept true (on demand; not shipped in the package). Built by `scripts/generate-agents-md.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/generate-agents-md.mjs --check` passes.
- `llms.txt`: llms.txt index, package-root mirror. Built by `scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs --check` passes.
- `public/llms.txt`: llms.txt index (absolute links, no timestamp). Built by `scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs --check` passes.
- `public/llms-full.txt`: llms-full.txt: the system map body, DESIGN.md and the props digest. Built by `scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs --check` passes.
- `public/llms`: Per-topic llms slices: components, layout, scroll, tokens. Built by `scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs --check` passes.
- `public/hds-manifest.json`: Machine-readable inventory of components, categories and phase status. Built by `scripts/generate-manifest.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/check-token-rebake-needed.mjs` passes.
- `docs/sync-map.json`: One row per component joining source, manifest, docs page and Figma. Built by `scripts/check-sync-map.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/check-sync-map.mjs --check` passes.
- `DESIGN.md`: The visual spec for agents, built from DESIGN.source.md and the tokens. Built by `scripts/build-design-md.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/build-design-md.mjs --check` passes.
- `DESIGN-HANDOFF.md` (token tables): Token reference tables mirrored from hirobius.tokens.json. Built by `scripts/build-handoff.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/build-handoff.mjs --check` passes.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: Release notes, one entry per version. Built by `changesets (pnpm changeset:version)`; not freshness-checked.
- `UPGRADING.md`: What each release asks of a consumer, compiled from upgrade/releases. Built by `scripts/upgrade/compile.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/upgrade/compile.mjs --check` passes.
- `upgrade/index.json`: Every release with its breaking count, the floor and what is deprecated. Built by `scripts/upgrade/compile.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/upgrade/compile.mjs --check` passes.
- `figma/snapshot.json`: The Figma library as last recorded by the Sync plugin. Built by `scripts/figma-snapshot.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/check-figma-drift.mjs` passes.
- `figma/inventory.json`: Every page, component set and variant count in the Figma library. Built by `scripts/figma-inventory.mjs`; not freshness-checked.
- `figma/disposition.json`: What becomes of each Figma component. Built by `scripts/figma-disposition.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/figma-disposition.mjs --check` passes.
- `figma/code-connect.json`: Code Connect templates registry. Built by `scripts/generate-code-connect.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/check-code-connect.mjs` passes.
- `docs/DESIGN_LINKS.md`: Where each component lives in Figma, the docs site and source. Built by `scripts/figma-links.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/figma-links.mjs --check` passes.
- `eval/refs/INDEX.md`: The design refs index: every ref Adrian saved, its text card, fidelity and gaps, read by build agents instead of the images. Built by `scripts/eval-refs.mjs`; fresh when `node scripts/eval-refs.mjs --check` passes.

## Checked

Hand-kept, but a gate compares it with the code.

- `status.json` (updatedAt): updatedAt, which a commit to src/, scripts/ or docs/adr/ must not outpace. Checked by `scripts/check-record-freshness.mjs`.
- `status.json` (consistency): The agent-consistency figures, compared with the latest ledger entry. Checked by `scripts/check-status-claims.mjs`.
- `.status`: Per-branch one-line notes standing in for a status.json bump until pnpm status:fold. Checked by `scripts/check-record-freshness.mjs`.
- `README.md` (Open explorations): Open explorations, including the agent-consistency line. Checked by `scripts/check-status-claims.mjs`.
- `figma/MCP-LEDGER.md`: Append-only log of every Figma MCP call an agent session makes (the budget record); it has no review age. Checked by `scripts/__tests__/figma-one-library-rule.test.mjs`.
- `docs/guardrails/registry.json`: Every gate, where it fires and its proof-of-firing fixtures. Checked by `scripts/validate-guardrail-registry.mjs`.
- `eval/consistency/ledger.json`: Append-only record of agent-consistency eval runs. Checked by `scripts/check-status-claims.mjs`.
- `eval/refs/decisions.json`: Append-only history of the design-refs review board: approved, rejected (with a reason) and deferred proposals. Checked by `scripts/eval-refs.mjs`.

## Editorial

Written by a person; the registry carries when it was last re-read. `pnpm check:state-surfaces` warns "review due" past the re-read window and fails under `--strict-review`.

- `status.json` (focus, phase, note): Where the repo is heading: focus, phase and note (v2 shape; ops derives release, next and blocked live). Reviewed 2026-10-12, re-read within 45 days.
